judge.rationale: The candidate only produced a planning document (`.lore/dod.md`) and a failing acceptance test (`src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`), without writing any implementation code at all. None of the production files (`src/types/messages.ts`, `validation.ts`, `messageHandler.ts`, `createServer.ts`, `config.ts`, etc.), specs, or documentation were modified. Consequently, the added test suite fails immediately on the unimplemented `list_conversations` frame, leaving the feature completely unimplemented and the test suite broken. Even within the two acceptance tests it wrote, the assertion `toEqual(['conv-c', 'conv-b', 'conv-a'])` is inaccurate against the issue's requirement because a fresh connection creates its own session in the store, which also appears in the returned conversation list.
